ChadMusic is a universal audio playing Discord bot for your Discord server that is easy to self-host yourself. It's built using a modified [fork](https://github.com/200percentmicky/chadtube) of **[DisTube.js](https://distube.js.org)**.

### 📑 **[Read the Documentation](https://200percentmicky.github.io/chadmusic)**

## Features

* Supports over 700+ websites.
  * This includes every website that is supported by [yt-dlp](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/supportedsites.md).
* Supports audio and video (audio-only) files.
  * Supports any audio or video uploaded to Discord.
  * Supports playing any directly uploaded files on a web server.
* Ffmpeg filter support.
  * Add multiple filters to the player.
  * Change their values anytime during playback.
  * Add any custom Ffmpeg audio filter.
* Unlimited volume! 😂👌
* Hide tracks by silently adding them. 🤫
* Moderate how the player works.
  * Set how many tracks can be added to the queue.
  * Limit how long the duration of a track can be.
  * Blocklist search terms.
    * Prevents members from adding anything that's blocked to the player.
  * Active DJ mode.
  * Only allow the player to be used in a text and voice channel.
  * Disable unlimited volume support by limiting it to 200%.
  * Set the default volume of the player when its created.
  * Log every action that is done to the player and queue.
  * Prevent users from adding explicit tracks to the queue.
  * Block NSFW websites.
  * Disable URL support.
  * Etc...
* Slash commands w/ auto-completion.
* ???
* Profit!
